terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

reason.description: The reason; for a manual /compact it is shown to the user.

title: PreCompact hook output
description: Can block compaction. Exit code 2 blocks it too. When the hook exits 0 without blocking, its plain stdout becomes instructions for the compaction summary. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
